system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the controller, engineer and researcher are made aware of the output of the previous steps in the plan via a common block injected into their system message

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we have built two context agents, i.e., agents with extended context in their system message
env_context_strategy.note: Context agents (full docs in system message) plus RAG agents over vector embeddings (Sec. 2.3); closest value mixed.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: At the end of every step in the plan, the agents and the entire chat history are reset and only the system context is carried over to the next step.

observation_format.note: Paper only; no observation conversion code. Vision language model integration mentioned in Author Contributions.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: an executor agent that executes the provided code block locally

tool_count.note: No tool registry available; paper only.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool definitions in evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: No source/dependencies in evidence to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Given an input task, the system first goes through a Planning phase in which a plan is designed and approved. A Control phase follows, in which the plan is executed by the Control agents.
loop_primitives.note: Engineer retries on failed execution up to nfails (generate_test_repair). One Shot mode also offered (Sec. 4).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Once the definitive plan is approved by the reviewer, it is stored into context and saved as a JSON file

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the controller, which distributes the assigned sub-tasks in the plan to the relevant agents

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a post-execution interpreter agent, which decides on which agent to transfer to
delegation_mechanism.note: AG2 swarm-style transfers; nested chat for engineer.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: also offering offers One Shot and Human-in- the-loop modes for less complex tasks
human_in_loop.note: Default Planning & Control has no human-in-the-loop; HITL mode selectable. Quote spans line break in PDF text.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the context variables that have been updated by the agents are recorded and passed on to the start of the next step

long_term_memory.note: RAG over docs/papers is domain knowledge, not cross-run memory; no config surface.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the plan reviewer, which provides feedback on the proposed plan
self_verification.note: Separate reviewer/interpreter agents; code execution results fed back via interpreter.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If the number of failed execution is less than nfails (a hyperparameter that can be specified by the user)

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If the number of failed executions reaches nfails, the system transitions to a terminator agent and the full session ends.

cost_controls.note: Cost displayed and stored; context reset reduces cost, but no budget cap reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: an executor agent that executes the provided code block locally

tracing.evidence_quote: for traceability, the structured responses of each agent (the plans and the plan feedback) are recorded into the session context by recorder agents

eval_hooks.note: Evaluation code referenced but location not given.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We present a multi-agent system for automation of scientific research tasks, cmbagent.

open_source.evidence_quote: The source code is available on GitHub

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: its agents leverage state-of-the-art LLMs through API interfaces with OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Open Source Planning & Control System with Language Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
primary_artifact.note: Only the paper was in the evidence bundle; repo exists but was not provided.

first_release_date.note: Fallback to paper date; this is v2 date, v1 date not in evidence; no tag info.
